messages:
nora: heads-up: kicking off a small canary at 09:00 UTC to validate proration math for Reserved/Dedicated tenants (reserved discounts + mid-period scale changes).
ajay: scope? how many tenants and which partitions?
nora: 5 tenants, single topic partition in us-east-1. routing_tag=prorate_canary. we will route only traffic that hits the dedicated pool.
maya: what are we exercising exactly? prorate on plan swap, reserved cap burn, and invoice_preview integrity.
sam: also check metrics when a tenant scales up mid-billing-cycle (reserved->burst) 1 that usually trips the prorate code path.
zack: console changes needed: invoice-preview should show a "proration_breakdown" row per-tenant (reserved_amount, usage_amount, prorate_factor, rounding_adjustment). ops folks want a quick export CSV.
ops-bot: created dashboard card: https://console.internal.redwood/d/prorate_canary 1 panels: ingest-rate(4), billing-latency(9), prorate-delta(12). alert rule "prorate-delta-pct" at 0.4% firing.
billing-eng: required: add "prorate_factor" to enrichment payload and to ledger transform so invoice preview and ledger use same inputs. mismatch last month caused 0.03% undercharge.
ajay: note: new factor depends on price-service v2 that uses monthly_commit_days. If price-service unavailable we should fallback to legacy-day-weighted factor. add circuit-breaker.
maya: fallback implemented: feature_flag=prorate_v2, fallback->legacy_factor(). sample code: ```python
if flags.on('prorate_v2'):
  factor = pricing.v2(prices, start,end)
else:
  factor = legacy_day_weighted(prices,start,end)
```
sam: telemetry ask: emit a sampled (0.5%) compare event: enrichment.prorate_factor vs ledger.applied_factor with raw_tokens and billed_tokens attached. send to validation stream.
zack: also add a small reconciliation SQL for ops to run: ```sql
select tenant_id, sum(billed_tokens) as b, sum(raw_tokens) as r, round((b/r)::numeric,6) as observed_factor
from invoice_preview
where routing_tag = 'prorate_canary'
group by tenant_id;
```
ops-bot: created runbook: "prorate-canary-playbook" with steps to flip flag, monitor dashboard, and rollback.
irma (ops): ping  not in participants? ignore
billing-eng: acceptance tests: (1) invoice preview and ledger must match within $0.01 per-tenant for the canary tenants, (2) rounding_adjustment sum must be <= $0.10 per-tenant.
ajay: dedupe note: if we replay events from dedicated pool we must preserve original timestamps for proration windows. Replay tool has --preserve-ts flag.
maya: preflight checklist run in staging: generated 1k synthetic scale-change events and verified factor calc. moving to prod canary.
[09:00] ops-bot: deployment job prorate-canary-started (job id: job-9077). applied routing_tag=prorate_canary to 5 tenants.
[09:25] nora: seeing increased billing-latency ~250ms median (baseline 110ms). investigating enrich lambda pressure.
sam: increase enrich concurrency for partition temporarily to avoid backpressure. scaling now.
[09:40] zack: dashboard shows prorate-delta pct = 0.12% across 5 tenants, under thresholds. good.
[09:55] billing-eng: small anomaly: tenant t-117 shows observed_factor != expected by ~0.00075. digging into rounding rules.
ajay: found a rounding edge-case: the new pricing v2 applies per-day rounding whereas ledger expected per-line rounding. That explains the penny differences.
maya: roll forward plan: toggle feature_flag off for tenant t-117 and re-run preview; pause expansion to more tenants.
[10:05] ops-bot: feature_flag toggled: prorate_v2 off for t-117. invoice-preview re-run queued.
[10:18] zack: after toggle, t-117 preview matches ledger within $0.01. looks like per-line vs per-period rounding mismatch.
billing-eng: creating ENG-BILL-430: "proration rounding semantics mismatch between pricing-service v2 and ledger transform". assigning to ajay + maya.
ajay: will implement unified rounding util and add unit tests for per-line and per-period modes.
sam: follow-up telemetry: emit a histogram of rounding_adjustment cents per-tenant for canary cohort. set alert if > 10 cents median.
ops-bot: alert rule created: prorate-rounding-median > 0.10 USD.
nora: timeline: keep canary paused. fix landed in a branch, run canary again in 48h after tests pass.
maya: lesson: need a preflight diff that compares invoice-preview vs ledger on a synthetic replay in prod-like environment before tagging tenants. adding to backlogs.
zack: small console UX: for canary tenants show a little yellow badge "prorate-canary" on invoice-preview and a 1-click "exclude from statement" option. ops asked for that.
billing-eng: also ensure backfill job honors exclude flag so we don't accidentally bill canary results.
[10:55] ops-bot: job job-9077 completed: paused after toggles; canary cohort unchanged.
